name: Psychokinetic Assault
description: Strike your foes with manifested whips and swords. Each strike manifests a psychokinetic sword that will fight alongside you for a short time

powers.name: Psi-Whip Lash
powers.description: You manifest your whip, striking your target for minor damage and manifesting a Psychokinetic sword. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Psi-Blade Slash
powers.description: You manifest your sword and slash for high damage and manifesting a Psychokinetic sword. Damage: High Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Psi-Whip Crack
powers.description: You manifest your whip and Lash out at your foe dealing moderate damage and also manifesting a Psychokinetic sword. Lash has has a chance to knockdown your target. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Psi-Whip Thrash
powers.description: You manifest your whip and make an impressive sweep causing moderate damage to enemies within a wide cone and also manifesting swords for each target hit. Targets that are struck may be knocked down. This Attack does not need a target to activate. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Manifest
powers.description: You manifest several Psychokinetic swords while boosting your damage and the secondary effects of your powers. Your powers' effects like Heals, Defense Buffs, Endurance Drains, Disorients, Holds, Immobilizes and more, are all improved. These effects last a short while, and only the next couple of attacks will be boosted. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Psi-Blade Spin
powers.description: You perform a spin with your manifested sword, dealing moderate damage to all nearby targets, each target hit spawns a Psychokinetic sword.  Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Long

powers.name: Psi-Blade Slam
powers.description: You perform a devastating slam with your manifested sword that deals a massive amount of damage and can even knock a foe down to the ground. The power of this attack can actually extend a short distance through multiple foes. Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Psychokinetic Pulse
powers.description: While active, you pulse out waves of Psychokinetic force, slowing the movement speed of all nearby foes, as well as having a chance to knock them down. Recharge: Very Fast
powers.shortHelp: Toggle PBAoE, Minor DMG(Psionic/Energy), Slow, Chance for knock up

powers.name: Psi-Whip Coil
powers.description: You coil your manifested whip around your target dealing high damage and holding them. Damage: High(DoT), Recharge: Slow
